title: AgenticPaymentTranscript
description: Schema for simulated agentic payment fraud and legitimate transaction transcripts.

conversation_id.description: Unique identifier for the simulated transcript (e.g., inj-1001, poison-1001, legit-1001).

attack_type.description: The category of the simulated conversation.

turn_count.description: Number of turns in the turns list.

content.description: The text content or payload of the turn.

metadata.description: Optional metadata, e.g., strategies, annotations, or tool metadata.

final_transfer_attempted.description: Whether the agent initiated a fund transfer call at the end of the conversation.

payee_id.description: The target payee ID (null if no transfer was attempted).

amount.description: Transaction amount (null if no transfer was attempted).

currency.description: Currency code (null if no transfer was attempted).

source_of_instruction.description: Taint tracking classification for the source of the payment instruction.

notes.description: Developer notes regarding strategies, persona types, or bypass criteria.

known_payee.description: Whether the destination payee was known or registered before the conversation.

payee_first_mentioned_turn.description: First turn where the final transfer payee appears.

payment_requested_turn.description: Turn where the payment request or transfer attempt occurs.

payee_introduced_by.description: Role that first introduced the final transfer payee.

risk_factors.description: Pre-labeled indicators useful for auditing and feature engineering.

attack_successful.description: Whether the simulated attack produced an attempted transfer to the risky target.

retrieved_documents.description: External documents retrieved during recommendation or merchant-content flows.

recommended_payee_id.description: Payee recommended by the assistant during recommendation-bias simulations.

competing_options_suppressed.description: Whether the transcript shows one option being favored while alternatives are downplayed.
